cases.name: chunk_boundary
assert: length 1 uses one read of length 1
length 1024 uses one read of length 1024
length 1025 uses reads of 1024 and 1 when the stored length stays stable

cases.name: mutable_length
assert: reloads length after each helper call
continues or exits using the reloaded value

cases.name: helper_error
assert: offset progression and return do not encode helper status

cases.name: signed_return
assert: returns sign-extension of the low 32-bit offset

note: Oracle is a design record, not executed; static core gates are the acceptance evidence.
